sections.title: Open the dashboard and choose a trip
items: Use the trip dropdown at the top of the page to choose the trip you want to review.
When you change the selected trip in the dashboard, Plantour also updates the current trip context for the rest of the app.

sections.title: Open the dashboard sections you need
items: Trip info shows the current trip overview and summary metrics.
User Trip info shows your own progress, assignments, and packing status for that trip.
All Users Trip info shows the wider team view with shared responsibilities and overall progress.
sections.afterHtml: Click a section row to expand it, and click it again to collapse it.

sections.title: When to use the dashboard
items: Use it when you want a quick overview before opening detailed trip pages.
Use it to see progress for yourself and for the whole trip without switching through every trip page one by one.
Use it to confirm that the correct trip is selected before you continue into trip-specific pages.
